found.non_cancelable_share: About 80% 'non-cancelable or requires payment regardless of usage' (roughly $414B by my arithmetic). Breakdown per Reuters: Broadcom-related equipment leases ~$161.2B (largely non-cancelable; neither party can terminate except on default); Google at least $111.1B (Apr 2026-Jul 2033, shortfall top-up); Amazon $110B (May 2026-Apr 2036, similar terms); xAI/SpaceX up to $84.5B through 2029 (largely cancelable on 90 days' notice); Microsoft $31.4B (Nov 2026-May 2033, non-cancelable except uncured Microsoft breach); AMD capacity expected to exceed $20B (AMD also to buy up to $5B of Anthropic stock).
found.information_gw: At least 14.8 GW of capacity contracted in 11 months (since Oct 2025), on top of 1-2 GW already held; Amazon+Google 11 GW (>$300B over 10 years); Microsoft $30B/1 GW; SpaceX up to $45B; Lambda+Nscale $80B (as re-reported by Chosunbiz/BigGo, which garble the MW figure); Fluidstack $50B. I could not find any source for a $531B figure (517 + 13.7 RUM = 530.7 is arithmetic only).
found.notes: (1) Prospectus: 'at least $518 billion over a decade ... with six partners' (Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom, xAI, AMD; components sum to 498.2 + AMD >20 = ~518), a mix of minimum/non-cancelable commitments and 'up to' ceilings, not a single funded amount; it is a confidential S-1 (filed June 1, 2026) seen by Reuters, not on EDGAR. Reuters' separate exclusive (2026-09-29): end-2025 non-cancellable hosting commitments $54.6B; by early 2026 total long-term commitments >$417B covering 3.5 GW. (2) The Information (2026-09-06, paywalled; opened only via re-reports): up to $517B, compiled from company announcements and reports, 'mostly across the next decade'; it is an aggregate of announced/reported deals, well above the ~$180B of server-leasing spend through 2029 shown to investors in Dec 2025. (3) Other: Anthropic's own GW list (May 2026): Amazon up to 5 GW, Google+Broadcom 5 GW, Microsoft/NVIDIA $30B, Fluidstack $50B. Deals outside the six-partner $518B (RUM $13.7B, Akamai $11.6B, TeraWulf ~$19B, Lambda $35B, Nscale ~$44.6B; also Riot $9.1B per Bloomberg 2026-08-10, Volta $10B and CoreWeave per press) are not in the prospectus total; the Information's $517B and the prospectus's $518B are different constructions that happen to land close.
